heading: Authorization of appropriations
lead: There are authorized to be appropriated the following amounts for the following fiscal years to carry out the purposes of this subchapter: For fiscal year:The amount authorized is: 1999 $5,000,000. 2000 $7,500,000. 2001 $10,000,000. 2002 $12,500,000. 2003 $15,000,000. 2004 $15,000,000. 2005 $15,000,000.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2004—Pub. L. 108–458 in table inserted items specifying amounts authorized for fiscal years 2004 and 2005.
